user.title: ZigEmu
user.description: Emulated EmberZNet (EZSP) Zigbee coordinators. After setup, open the ZigEmu panel to create coordinators: each one listens on its own TCP port, and a Zigbee host connects to it like to a network-attached Ember stick (ZHA: `socket://<host>:<port>`, Zigbee2MQTT: `adapter: ember`, `port: tcp://<host>:<port>`).
